children: Palm oil declines in Asian trading, weighed by rising stock levels in Malaysia, AmInvestment Bank says in a note. Technical analysis suggests crude palm oil futures could remain under pressure. The market may attempt a technical rebound, but significant resistance remains, it adds. AmInvestment Bank expects CPO futures to find support at 4,288 ringgit a ton and face resistance at 4,478 ringgit a ton. The Bursa Malaysia Derivatives contract for February delivery is 26 ringgit lower at 4,307 ringgit a ton. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
